requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest and booking at the facility
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest and booking at the facility
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no booking fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were arrested and booked, from your records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Booking number at the facility, if known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Booking number at the facility, if known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no booking identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your booking number if you know it - the request is effective without it, and you add it if the facility asks

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the offense in court, if there was one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the offense in court, if there was one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court case number, if the offense had one, copied from the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County or municipality where the facility is located
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County or municipality where the facility is located
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the facility's location is a case fact the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Georgia county or municipality the facility belongs to

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Postal destination or records-unit intake route confirmed with the facility
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Postal destination or records-unit intake route confirmed with the facility
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no intake address for any facility and the legal-design record forbids guessing one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: where the facility told you to send a records-restriction request - facility intake routes vary and must be confirmed with that facility, never guessed

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Facility the request is addressed to - the county or municipal jail or detention center that booked you
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Facility the request is addressed to - the county or municipal jail or detention center that booked you
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which facility holds the booking records is a case fact the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the jail or detention center that booked you for the restricted offense

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Offense already restricted under O.C.G.A. Sec. 35-3-37, worded as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Offense already restricted under O.C.G.A. Sec. 35-3-37, worded as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offense fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the restricted offense, worded exactly as your criminal history report or the restricting order states it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the record was restricted, as far as the record shows
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the record was restricted, as far as the record shows
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no restriction fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the restriction date, as your report or the order shows it

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the written request
protectedBlanks.why: the request is the participant's own and is signed when actually sent

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is actually sent would be false
